summary.intent: Run the GSD 'discuss' phase workflow for Phase 65 (SDK Write-Chain, Bin Re-link, and Invite Claim) to surface and lock implementation decisions, then produce a CONTEXT.md for downstream researcher and planner agents.
summary.outcome: All five key decisions were locked through structured discussion and written to `65-CONTEXT.md` and `65-DISCUSSION-LOG.md`, committed to git. The phase boundary, Q3 authority model, co-writer offline handling, e2e test gate, and folded todo were all resolved.

repo: Phase 62 codec already built the write-body infrastructure (seal.ts: writeBody/writeSealed/role-0x04/encodeWriteBody/decodeWriteBody, sealNode, unsealNode) — Phase 65 wires callers, does not build new codec.
`shared-write.ts` is a fully stubbed implementation file where every function throws 'not implemented — phase 65 (write-chain)' — it is the primary implementation target for Phase 65.
`reWrapForRecipients` was already removed from the sdk layer in Phase 63; only the apps/web copy remains and is deferred to Phase 68.

Deletion targets from the design doc (`addShareKeys`, `reWrapForRecipients`, `encryptedChildKeys`, `originalFolderKeyEncrypted`) split across Phases 65/66/68 strictly by layer — sdk vs apps/api vs apps/web.

Q3 (writer-vs-owner sub-share authority): chosen approach is reconcile-on-owner-sync — the delegate (C) unlinks+bins immediately, no cross-principal revoke attempt; residual exposure is documented and the reconcile seam is wired live in Phase 66/68.
ADR 0001 ratified full Ed25519 rotation as the write-revocation mechanism: new keypair + k51 name per node, parent re-point cascade to share root, tombstone old names.

Mock-seam discipline (D-04) from Phase 64 carries forward: tombstone enforcement and `writeDescriptorRef` co-writer persistence are mock-tested behind injected callbacks in Phase 65; live DB/publish-gate cutover is Phase 66.

code.finding: All functions are stubbed with `throw 'not implemented — phase 65 (write-chain)'`; this is the core implementation target for Phase 65.
Already supports writeBody/writeSealed/role-0x04/encodeWriteBody/decodeWriteBody and sealNode(node, readKey, writeKey)/unsealNode(…, writeKey?) from Phase 62; Phase 65 calls this, does not extend it.

workflow: The AskUserQuestion tool can be silently rejected; when this happens the assistant may incorrectly fall back to inline text, skipping the structured question UI — the user must explicitly flag this to get back on track.
Verifying deletion targets against the current codebase state (not just design-doc file:lines) is essential before writing CONTEXT.md, because prior phases may have already removed some targets.

The discuss-phase workflow separates locked decisions (from design doc + ADRs + prior phase contexts) from genuine gray areas — only the gray areas go to the user for discussion, avoiding re-litigating settled choices.

friction: AskUserQuestion tool was rejected on first invocation, causing the assistant to skip the structured question UI entirely and present decisions as plain text — user had to explicitly ask 'why are the questions being skipped?' to restore the correct flow.
A prior Phase 54 discuss session was interrupted mid-run before any output was produced, requiring a full restart under Phase 65.
open_items: `addShareKeys` apps/api endpoint cleanup deferred to Phase 66.
`addShareKeysFn` client.ts callback type quarantined to Phase 68.
Tombstone enforcement (publish-gate reject, resolve 410) and `writeDescriptorRef` co-writer persistence: mock-tested in Phase 65, live cutover in Phase 66.
Q3 reconcile seam (re-derive shares WHERE rootNodeId IN destroyed-subtree) wired live in Phase 66/68 — no new schema this phase.
Co-writer grace-period and notification UX deferred to Phase 68 Q1.
Rotation follow-ups RR-01 (merge) and RR-02 (resume) deferred to Phase 66/68.
Writer-vs-owner cross-principal revocation (Q3 option c: owner-signed revocation queue) noted as a future feature idea, not built.
